title: piqueria peruviana
intro: Piqueria peruviana, commonly known as Piqueria, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Piqueria peruviana include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Piqueria peruviana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
